metadata.notes: Baseline for sift-email (issue #111), evals 1-21, two runs each, with run-mcp-trials.sh against the Gmail, Claude Docs, and Contacts stubs, on SKILL.md as committed with this baseline. The skill sets disable-model-invocation, so every eval prompt starts with /sift-email; every trial ran the skill through that slash command. Both runs were on 2026-10-12 in the fixtures' rubric timezone (fixtures anchored to 2026-10-10, not shifted), and graders held "the run date" to the date the run's clock gave in that timezone. No failures. Date check, not part of the scores: evals 5, 15, and 20 were run once more with the trial machine at UTC+14 (TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati), a day ahead of the rubric's timezone; each read the clock in the rubric's timezone and wrote only that date (2026-10-12) in log headings, changelog entries, and About me notes, where the previous baseline's runs dated changelog entries with the machine's date. Not graded, seen in a few trials: first person for the user in doc text (eval 5 run 1, tracked in #112), a log summary whose counts disagree with the labels applied (eval 2 run 1), About me notes with a thin or wrong source, lookups of a sender About me already covers, user labels searched by name instead of id, Step 2 checks skipped, and replies opening with process narration.
